integrity: The proof uses the full primary source's exact equivalence between segment-multiplier boundedness and the truncated Muckenhoupt class, then computes the relevant reciprocal integrability threshold and small-interval classical Muckenhoupt asymptotic directly. No numerical experiment or finite truncation is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies one natural critical power-log family rather than arbitrary slowly varying corrections. It gives the exact large-scale membership threshold and characteristic blow-up, but not a sharp operator-norm formula for the segment multiplier.
title: Exact logarithmic repair threshold for the weighted segment multiplier
